Printed edition: Narrative of a voyage to the northwest coast of America in the years 1811, 1812, 1813, and 1814; or, The first American settlement of the Pacific, New York, Redfield, 1854, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/narrativeofvoyag00fran.
